image_prompt: A haggard, middle-aged man with sunken features and a gaunt, emaciated frame. His skin is pale and sallow, tinged with a sickly, greenish hue. Deep shadows linger beneath his hollow, haunted eyes, which dart about restlessly, as if plagued by visions only he can perceive. Stringy, unkempt hair the color of tarnished silver frames his angular, gaunt face, and his chapped, cracked lips are twisted into a weary, despairing expression. He is dressed in tattered, ill-fitting clothes - a threadbare, stained shirt, faded trousers, and worn, scuffed boots. An air of profound unease and barely-contained madness clings to him, hinting at the horrors he has endured.
